title: Passage and Provision
author: Silas Joubert
blurb: Coral Okonkwo, a salvage diver working a wreck the navy won't discuss, carries a compass, a debt, and very little else. But when an expedition upriver stops answering the radio, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, they must cross the range ahead of the snows before the glacier calving season opens the route — briefly.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
